name: Spare Planks
desc: Instantly gain 1 wall. Does not use your turn.

name: Builder Kit
desc: Instantly gain 2 walls. Does not use your turn.

name: Thin Barrier
desc: Place a short wall, 1 tile long.

name: Free Brick
desc: Place a normal wall without spending a wall.

name: Quick Stride
desc: Move up to 2 squares in a straight, unblocked line.

name: Side Step
desc: Move diagonally one tile via an open corner.

name: Emergency Stash
desc: Instantly gain 3 walls. Does not use your turn.

name: Long Barricade
desc: Place a wall 3 tiles long, costs 1 wall.

name: Wall Hopper
desc: Step across an adjacent wall; destination must remain escapable.

name: Sprint
desc: Travel up to 3 clear squares in a straight line.

name: Reclaim
desc: Remove one of your walls and regain 2 wall units.

name: Drain Supplies
desc: Choose an opponent; they lose 1 wall.

name: Reserve Supply
desc: Instantly gain 2 walls and keep your turn.

name: Cross Jump
desc: Blink exactly 2 tiles in a straight line, over walls if needed.

name: Demolition
desc: Remove any wall on the board.

name: Free Long Wall
desc: Place a 3-tile wall for free.

name: Double Build
desc: Build a normal wall, then receive one extra action.

name: Long Vault
desc: Move up to 2 tiles, crossing walls on the way.

name: Supply Heist
desc: Take up to 2 walls from a chosen opponent.

name: Second Wind
desc: Move normally, then take one extra action.

name: Great Wall
desc: Place a 4-tile wall for one wall unit.

name: Phantom Step
desc: Blink exactly 3 tiles in a straight line, ignoring intervening walls.

name: Wall Storm
desc: Place a 3-tile wall, then take one extra action.

name: Super Cache
desc: Instantly gain 5 walls. Does not use your turn.

name: Wrecking Ball
desc: Destroy a selected wall plus any wall touching it.

name: Portal
desc: Teleport to any free square within 3 steps (Manhattan distance).

name: Fortress
desc: Place a 4-tile wall for free and receive an extra action.

name: Master Builder
desc: Instantly gain 7 walls, without ending your turn.
